title: Tender Skillet Pork Tenderloin
description: A flavorful and tender pork tenderloin cooked to perfection in a skillet with an Indian-inspired spice blend.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the pork tenderloin with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of luscious spice blend.
Add the olive oil to the preheated skillet and swirl to coat.
Sear the pork tenderloin for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Return the pork tenderloin to the skillet and brush with lemon juice.
Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
